content_sections.heading: DHS Godda Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The 64 DHS Godda vacancies are spread across 33 post categories under various National Health Mission sub-programmes (RCH, RBSK, RNTCP, NPHCE, NMHP, IDSP, NPCDCS, and Urban PHCs). Category-wise distribution as per the notification is given below. Total: 64 posts (UR-42, BC1-3, BC2-0, SC-4, ST-15, EWS-0), as stated in the notification's summary row.

rows.essential_qualification_summary: 10+2/Intermediate with 3 years' General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) training from a Govt recognized institution; registered under Jharkhand Nursing Council; at least 2 years' hospital/health institution experience (SNCU post)
10+2/intermediate with Diploma/certificate course in Operation Theatre Technician; registered under Pharmacy Council, Jharkhand; at least 1 year hospital/health institution experience

rows.post: Oxygen Operator – PSA Plant, DH Godda
rows.essential_qualification_summary: Diploma in Engineering or equivalent technical certification (Mechanical/Electrical)/B.Tech (Mechanical/Electrical); at least 1 year experience operating/maintaining oxygen generation plants
Same as Staff Nurse (SNCU) above

Graduation with a 1-year diploma/PG Diploma in Computer Application, DOEACC 'O' Level, ITI/IDTR, or Bachelor in Computer Application/B.Sc (IT)/B.Sc (Computer Science)/DOEACC 'A' level; minimum 2 years' post-qualification relevant experience
Two-year Diploma in Optometry, or trained as Ophthalmic Assistant at an NPCB-recognized Govt hospital; familiarity with computer and internet use

rows.post: Pharmacist (RBSK / RNTCP / Drug Store / UPHC Mahagama)
rows.essential_qualification_summary: Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized institute; registered under (Jharkhand State) Pharmacy Council; computer proficiency (MS Office) & Internet; at least 2 years' hospital/health institution experience (RBSK/RNTCP/Drug Store posts)

Graduate + Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent from a Govt recognized institute; permanent two-wheeler driving licence; computer operation certificate (minimum 2 months); desirable: minimum 1 year RNTCP experience
10+2/intermediate + Diploma in X-Ray Technology/Radiology from a Govt recognized institute with 2 years' Medical Lab experience; registered under Jharkhand Paramedical Council

Post Graduate + 1 year experience in communication/ACSM/public-private partnership/health projects; permanent two-wheeler driving licence; preference to RNTCP experience and Social Sciences/Mass Media/Communication/Rural Development background
Graduate, preferably in Biology stream (Science in Class XII considered if a Biology graduate is unavailable); 1 year experience in vector-borne disease work; valid two-wheeler driving licence

Graduate, OR Intermediate (10+2) in Science with experience as MPW/LHV/ANM/Health Worker plus a certificate/higher course in health education/counselling, or a Tuberculosis Health Visitor's course; computer operations certificate (minimum 2 months)
Essential: Matriculation; Desirable: 2 years' hospital work experience

10+2 or equivalent + 1.5-year certificate course in Multi Rehabilitation Work from a recognized institute; registered as Rehabilitation personnel under the Rehabilitation Council of India Act, 1992; desirable: at least 1 year hospital experience

First or Second Class M.Phil in Clinical Psychology/M.Phil Psychiatric Social Work/M.A./M.Sc in Psychology, or First/Second Class M.A./M.S.W in Medical Psychiatric Social Work/M.Sc in Psychiatric Nursing, from an institute recognized as per Indian Nursing Council

Medical Graduate with Postgraduate Degree/Diploma in Preventive & Social Medicine/Public Health/Epidemiology (MD, MPH, DPH, MAE, etc.), OR any Medical Graduate with 2 years' Epidemiology/Public Health experience; minimum 2 years' experience in public health/epidemiology programmes

rows.post: Lab Technician (IDSP / MFP Fluorosis / UPHC Mahagama)
rows.essential_qualification_summary: 10+2/intermediate + Diploma in Lab Technician from a Govt recognized institute with 1 year experience; registered under Jharkhand Paramedical Council
Graduation + 3 years' working experience with a Government/Government-aided body or NGO handling vaccines in cold chain

Postgraduate Degree in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human Development, or a Diploma in Nursing, with minimum 1 year experience in Adolescent work; knowledge of Adolescent Developmental Stage; good working knowledge of MS Office (block-level position)

rows.post: Counsellor (Blood Bank / NPCDCS) / RMNCH FP Counsellor
rows.essential_qualification_summary: Master's/Bachelor's Degree in Social Work/Public Administration/Psychology/Sociology/Home Science/Hospital & Health Management; 1 year work experience in health sector or relevant field; basic computer skills (MS Office)

Female candidates only; Master's/Bachelor's degree in Food and Nutrition/Home Science (Hons/Pass); 1 year health sector experience; basic computer skills; good data management skills; ability to work in a team
10+2 or equivalent examination with a completed ANM course from an institution recognized by the Govt and approved by the Indian Nursing Council (INC); registered under Jharkhand Nursing Council

content_sections.heading: DHS Godda Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a maximum of 100 points, distributed as follows: Points for items 1–4 are awarded on a pro-rata basis (e.g. a candidate scoring 60% marks receives 60% of the points allotted to that section). If, after scrutiny, the number of applications received for a post is fewer than 10, the merit list is prepared using only the educational/training marking scheme (no written test/skill test is held for that post). If applications after scrutiny exceed 10, a Written Test/Skill Test is conducted, and the merit list combines educational, training, and written/skill test marks. Jharkhand's local residency and reservation policies apply, with preference given to Jharkhand state residents. The final merit list will be published at the Civil Surgeon's office and on the Godda district website (https://godda.nic.in), in two parts: Part-A (selected candidates) and Part-B (a one-year-valid waiting list).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: DHS Godda Recruitment 2026 applications must be submitted online only, through the Jharkhand Government's recruitment portal maintained by JAP IT, Ranchi. Visit https://recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in . Register/log in and complete the online application form between 06.08.2026 and 30.08.2026. Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph and your signature. Upload scanned copies of educational certificates, training certificates, mark sheets, domicile certificate (for reservation claims), caste certificate, Matriculation certificate (for date of birth), computer proficiency certificate (if applicable), and experience certificate (with salary payment proof and bank statement). Upload Aadhaar Card details as identity proof. Pay the applicable application fee (₹400 for General/BC/EBC/EWS, ₹200 for SC/ST) online via the payment link on the portal. Review all filled details for accuracy and submit the form. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Only one application per post is accepted - if multiple applications are submitted for the same post, the most recent one is treated as final and the rest are automatically rejected. Offline or postal applications will not be accepted under any circumstances.

content_sections.text: Recent passport-size colour photograph and scanned signature Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (post-wise, from Matriculation onwards) Training/professional certificates relevant to the post Domicile/residence certificate issued by the competent authority (for reservation claims) Caste certificate (for SC/ST/BC1/BC2/EWS candidates) Matriculation certificate as proof of date of birth Computer proficiency certificate (where applicable/admissible) Experience certificate, including salary payment proof and bank statement Aadhaar Card CGPA-to-percentage Conversion Chart (for candidates submitting a CGPA score card)

faq.question: Q1. What is DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contractual recruitment drive by the District Health Society, Godda, Jharkhand (Advt. No. 01/2026) to fill 64 posts under the National Health Mission across various health institutions in Godda district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 64 vacancies in total across 33 post categories, distributed as UR-42, BC1-3, BC2-0, SC-4, ST-15, and EWS-0, as stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closing date is 30.08.2026. Applications opened on 06.08.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for DHS Godda posts?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary widely by post - from Matriculation (Hospital/Sanitary Attendant) to Diploma/ANM/GNM (nursing and paramedical posts) to Postgraduate and Medical degrees (Epidemiologist, Clinical Psychologist, Psychiatric Social Worker). See the Eligibility Criteria table for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age is calculated as on 01.01.2026. The general maximum age limit is 35 years (40 for PwD), 37 years for Backward/Extremely Backward Class (42 for PwD), 40 years for SC/ST (45 for PwD), and 38 years for women in General/Backward/Extremely Backward categories (43 for PwD). Minimum age is 21 years for all categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹400 for General/Backward Class/Extremely Backward Class/EWS candidates, and ₹200 for SC/ST candidates, payable online.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online at https://recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in between 06.08.2026 and 30.08.2026. Offline or postal applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DHS Godda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 100-point scale: 10th marks (10 points), 12th marks (15 points), essential qualification (25 points), relevant higher qualification (10 points), and a Written Test/Skill Test (40 points). If fewer than 10 applications are received for a post after scrutiny, selection is based on academic/training marks alone, without a written test.
